name: k8s-contributor
description: Triage, fix, and verify Kubernetes issues with a parallel agent graph. Evidence-based verification gates, and it never commits, comments, or pushes on its own.

workspace_root.title: Workspace root
workspace_root.description: Parent directory holding your cloned kubernetes/* and kubernetes-sigs/* repos. Leave blank to use the current working directory.

community_docs_path.title: kubernetes/community clone
community_docs_path.description: Local clone of kubernetes/community, used as the source of truth for contributor guidelines. Leave blank to fetch and cache the canonical docs on first use.

default_kind_cluster_name.title: kind cluster name prefix
default_kind_cluster_name.description: Prefix for kind clusters created during cluster gates, so concurrent runs do not collide.

max_review_rounds.title: Max review rounds
max_review_rounds.description: Ceiling on the plan and review feedback loops before the run escalates to you instead of looping.

require_approval_before_commit.title: Require approval before commit (always on)
require_approval_before_commit.description: Always true. Setting this to false is NOT supported: the guard-destructive hook blocks commits, pushes, and GitHub comments regardless, and there is no bypass. The option exists only so this description can say so.
